summary.text: Reedy Berg is a Republican candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 15-Position 2, an open seat, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces Liz Hallock of the No Kings Party.
A history teacher and Yakima City Council member, he finished first in the August 4 primary.

paragraphs.text: Reedy Berg earned a bachelor's degree from Gonzaga University in 2011, according to Ballotpedia, and his career experience includes working as a history teacher.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Berg said he was raised in the Yakima Valley, graduated from Eisenhower High School, worked in the valley's agricultural industry, and later earned a master's degree from Heritage University.
He said he has taught history and civics at Toppenish Middle School since 2016, was elected to the Yakima City Council in 2024, and was chosen by fellow council members as Deputy Mayor in 2026.
In the August 4, 2026 primary for District 15-Position 2, Berg received 48.6 percent of the vote, ahead of Hallock with 30.1 percent and Republican Chase Foster with 21.3 percent.
His survey lists his key messages as empowering parenthood, protecting and strengthening agriculture, including preserving the H-2A guest worker program, and repealing the Climate Commitment Act.
